pictures.scene: Hendrick ter Brugghen, King David — the old king sitting in a heavy red and gold brocade cope over a white robe with a spiked gold crown on his grey head, his face turned up and his brows drawn as he looks away out of the picture, both worn hands at the strings of the tall harp beside him, and the singers crowded in close around him in the dark, one holding up a sheet of music and one bent over a book, a Psalm of David when he fled from his son Absalom
pictures.name: pd_brugghen_king_david

pictures.scene: Pieter Snayers, The Siege of Aire-sur-la-Lys — the whole country seen from a hill in winter, the star-shaped fortress sitting small out in the middle of the white plain and the siege lines drawn in a great ring right round it, tents and earthworks and columns of men running away into the distance as far as the eye goes, and in front along the ridge the pikes standing up in a thicket over the crowd of soldiers and camp followers on the snow, O LORD how my foes have increased, how many rise up against me
pictures.name: pd_snayers_the_siege_of_aire_sur_la_lys

pictures.scene: Matthias Stom, The Mocking of Christ — Christ sitting bound in the lamplight with a red robe thrown round His waist and His hands tied in His lap, His face lifted away from them and taking no notice, and the men pressing in out of the blue dark behind Him, one in a hat laughing with his mouth open, another leaning over His shoulder to jeer and a third rapping the reed down beside Him, many say of me, God will not deliver him
pictures.name: pd_stom_mocking_of_christ

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Man in Armour — the young soldier seen from the side out of a brown dark, a great gold helmet with a plume on his head and the light catching the steel breastplate and the gold at his shoulder, a heavy red cloak hanging down his back, his face quiet and turned down, and his gloved hand resting on the shield at his side, but You O LORD are a shield around me, my glory and the One who lifts my head
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_man_armour

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Cross in the Mountains — a wayside crucifix standing on the bare rock at the top of the peak with the firs crowding dark up the slope around it, the sun already gone down behind the summit and the rays coming up out of it through torn orange cloud, nobody anywhere on the mountain, to the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_the_cross_in_the_mountains

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Noon Rest from Work — the two harvesters lying down asleep on the straw in the middle of the day, both in blue working clothes, the woman with her head on her arm and a white cap over her face and the man beside her with his straw hat pulled down over his eyes, their wooden clogs kicked off on the stubble and the sickle lying by them, the cut corn heaped up in a great gold stack behind and the cart standing empty at the edge of the field, I lie down and sleep, I wake again for the LORD sustains me
pictures.name: pd_vangogh_noon_rest

pictures.scene: David Roberts, The Siege and Destruction of Jerusalem — the whole city spread out below under a sky full of smoke, the temple courts standing white inside their colonnades with the fires already starting along the walls, and the besieging army coming on in long columns up the valley and over the rocks on every side, thousands of them winding past the palms toward the gates, I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side
pictures.name: pd_roberts_the_siege_and_destruction_of_jerusalem

pictures.scene: Bartolome Bermejo, Saint Michael Triumphant over the Devil — the archangel standing in full gilt armour with a red cloak flying out behind him and his wings spread across the gold ground, the sword lifted over his head in both hands ready to come down, a jewelled shield held out in his other hand, and the beast beaten down under his feet with its claws and its red eyes and its teeth showing, while a man in a black cap kneels at the side with his book open, arise O LORD save me O my God, strike all my enemies on the jaw and break the teeth of the wicked
pictures.name: pd_bermejo_saint_michael_triumphant_over_the_devil

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Christ Giving His Blessing — pending, salvation belongs to the LORD, may Your blessing be on Your people
pictures.name: pd_memling_christ_giving_his_blessing

lines.text: when he fled from his son Absalom.
O LORD, how my foes have increased!
How many rise up against me!
But You, O LORD, are a shield around me,
my glory, and the One who lifts my head.
To the LORD I cry aloud,
and He answers me from His holy mountain.
I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
I will not fear the myriads
set against me on every side.
Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God!
Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
may Your blessing be on Your people.
